niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected-TV (CTV) advertising agency for every brand — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, audience, geography and whether you need creative, media-buying, programmatic, measurement or all of the above. I can recommend choices once I know more, but here’s a quick, practical way to find the best fit plus names and criteria to evaluate.

Quick questions so I can recommend agencies that match you:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, direct-response/performance, app installs, linear TV replacement)
- Budget range (monthly or campaign)?
- Markets/geography (US, EMEA, APAC, local)?
- Do you need creative production for 16:9/portrait/interactive CTV, or only media buying?
- Do you prefer a full-service holding-group agency or a specialist/independent?

Who to consider (safe starting points)
- Major holding groups with deep CTV capabilities: GroupM (Mindshare, Wavemaker), Omnicom Media Group (OMD, PHD), Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith), Dentsu (Carat). Good for large, global buys, advanced data and measurement.
- Independent/specialist firms with heavy CTV focus: look for advanced-TV specialists (names vary by market). Also consider performance-focused independents if you want direct-response results.
- Platform/tech partners (not agencies, but important partners): The Trade Desk (DSP), Roku Advertising, Amazon DSP, Google DV360, Samsung Ads, VideoAmp, The Roku and Hulu ad teams. Agencies often work through or alongside these platforms.

What makes an excellent CTV agency — checklist to use when evaluating:
- Demonstrated case studies for similar objectives and verticals (with outcomes).
- Programmatic buying expertise (DSPs, private marketplaces, PMP strategy).
- Strong measurement and verification: e.g., independent viewability/verification, integration with Nielsen/VideoAmp or other MRC-relevant measurement, incrementality testing.
- Cross-channel attribution capability (CTV + linear + digital/mobile).
- Creative expertise optimized for CTV viewing and interactive formats.
- Identity and targeting approaches that respect privacy but deliver addressability (deterministic matches, household-level targeting).
- Transparency on fees, media markup, data usage and reporting cadence.
- Platform partnerships (Roku, Samsung, major publishers) and direct access to inventory vs. thin supply through many intermediaries.
- Brand-safety/contextual targeting controls for premium streaming environments.

How I can help next
- If you share your answers to the quick questions above, I’ll shortlist 3–5 agencies (or agency types) matched to your objectives and budget, and give suggested interview questions and a scorecard to compare them.
